Abs.description: The absolute value of a number, of the same type.
Abs.title: Abs

AgentHandler.description: Send the event and the state to the agent.
AgentHandler.title: AgentHandler

And.description: True when all of 2 to `MAX_EXPR_ARGS` bools are. Type `bool`.
And.title: And

Box.description: Children in a row or a column.
Box.title: Box

Check.description: A check box with a label, two-way bound to a `bool` entry.
Check.title: Check

Concat.description: 2 to `MAX_EXPR_ARGS` strings joined in order. Type `string`; numbers need `format_number`.
Concat.title: Concat

Dropdown.description: A drop-down list of the options of an `enum` entry, two-way bound to it.
Dropdown.title: Dropdown

Entry.description: A one-line text field, two-way bound to a `string` entry.
Entry.title: Entry

EnumState.description: One of a fixed list of options (a dropdown). The value is the option's text.
EnumState.title: EnumState

Eq.description: `left == right`, for two numbers, two strings or two bools. Type `bool`.
Eq.title: Eq

Expander.description: A title that shows or hides its child.
Expander.title: Expander

FileRef.description: A file in the task's workspace.
FileRef.title: FileRef

FileState.description: A reference to a file in the workspace, or none yet.
FileState.title: FileState

FloatLit.description: A finite number. Type `float`; `5` is accepted and means 5.0.
FloatLit.title: FloatLit

FloatState.description: A finite number, optionally bounded. A slider or spin button needs both bounds.
FloatState.title: FloatState

FormatNumber.description:
A number as text, with a fixed count of decimals and optional digit grouping.

`decimals` is 0 to `MAX_DECIMALS`. `grouping` separates thousands. There is no format
string and no locale: the renderer always writes `.` before the decimals and `,` between
the groups, so a tool looks the same everywhere. Type `string`.
FormatNumber.title: FormatNumber

Grid.description: Children placed left to right, then top to bottom, `columns` to a row.
Grid.title: Grid

Heading.description: Like a label, larger. `level` 1 is the largest.
Heading.title: Heading

If.description:
`then` when `condition` is true, else `otherwise`.

The branches have the same type, or are both numbers (then the result is `float` if either
is). Only the chosen branch is meaningful, but both are always type-checked.
If.title: If

Image.description: The image an `image` entry refers to (nothing while the entry is empty).
Image.title: Image

ImageRef.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image in the task's workspace.
ImageRef.title: ImageRef

ImageState.description: A reference to a PNG, JPEG or WebP image in the workspace, or none yet.
ImageState.title: ImageState

IntLit.description: An integer within +-(2**53 - 1). Type `int`; `5.0` is not an integer here.
IntLit.title: IntLit

IntState.description: A whole number, optionally bounded. A slider or spin button needs both bounds.
IntState.title: IntState

JsonState.description: Any JSON value, for data that has no better type (and for composition ports).
JsonState.title: JsonState

Label.description: Plain text: static `text`, or the value of a `string` or `enum` entry (`bind`).
Label.title: Label

ListState.description: A list of scalars of one type.
ListState.title: ListState

Max.description: The largest of 2 to `MAX_EXPR_ARGS` numbers: `int` if all are, else `float`.
Max.title: Max

Min.description: The smallest of 2 to `MAX_EXPR_ARGS` numbers: `int` if all are, else `float`.
Min.title: Min

Ne.description: `left != right`, for two numbers, two strings or two bools. Type `bool`.
Ne.title: Ne

Not.description: The opposite of a bool. Type `bool`.
Not.title: Not

Or.description: True when any of 2 to `MAX_EXPR_ARGS` bools is. Type `bool`.
Or.title: Or

Progress.description: A bar showing an `int` or `float` entry between its `minimum` and `maximum`.
Progress.title: Progress

Ref.description: The current value of a state entry. Type: that of the entry (an enum is a `string`).
Ref.title: Ref

Round.description: A number rounded to the nearest whole number, as an `int`. Always `int`.
Round.title: Round

SandboxHandler.description: Call a function of one of the tool's code modules in a sandbox.
SandboxHandler.title: SandboxHandler

SetHandler.description: Assign expression results to state entries.
SetHandler.title: SetHandler

Slider.description: A slider, two-way bound to an `int` or `float` entry that has both bounds.
Slider.title: Slider

Spin.description: A spin button, two-way bound to an `int` or `float` entry that has both bounds.
Spin.title: Spin

StrLit.description: Authored text (block rules: no control characters but newline and tab). Type `string`.
StrLit.title: StrLit

StringState.description: Text of at most `max_length` characters. Whatever the user types is stored as is.
StringState.title: StringState

Switch.description: An on/off switch, two-way bound to a `bool` entry.
Switch.title: Switch

TabPage.description: One page of `tabs`: not a component itself.
TabPage.title: TabPage

Table.description:
Typed columns and rows of cells. A table value carries its own columns.

A state declaration of kind `table` bounds the value (`max_rows`) but does not fix its
columns, because a CSV viewer cannot know the headers of a file it has not read. Every row
has one cell per column, of that column's type; an `int` is accepted in a `float` column
and stored as a float. Rows are bounded by `MAX_TABLE_ROWS` and, with the columns, by
`MAX_TABLE_CELLS`; the text in it by `MAX_VALUE_TEXT_BYTES`. Column names are distinct once
normalised as the tool store does (NFC, line feeds).
Table.title: Table

TableColumn.description: One typed column. The name is the header the renderer shows.
TableColumn.title: TableColumn

TableState.description: Rows and columns. The value carries its own typed columns; this bounds the row count.
TableState.title: TableState

TableView.description: The rows and typed columns of a `table` entry.
TableView.title: TableView

Tabs.description: Pages, one visible at a time, with their titles as tabs.
Tabs.title: Tabs

TextView.description: Multi-line text bound to a `string` entry; two-way when `editable`, else read-only.
TextView.title: TextView
